name: PT. Media Nusantara Citra Tbk
summary: PT. Media Nusantara Citra Tbk operates as an integrated media company that produces and distributes various content on television and other platforms in Indonesia. The company operates through Television, Radio, Print and Online Media, Content, and Advertising Agency segments.
